_comment: A lone block of 96 Spearmen (6 files of 16) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B), which deals the half-file drill. Drill mode, no enemy. Each man follows a man he can see: the two middle files stand and the front rank keeps its ground while its file leaders open out on the guide's line, each wing outward, and the rear half of each file steps sideways into the interval on its outer side, then comes up it in column behind its half-file leader once the interval has opened where he is. The expects read the men's bodies. pairs_within_body_radius counts pairs of men whose centres stand closer than one body radius (4.5 wu), a man walking through another: 0 at ticks 120, 180 and 240, where main reads 2, 2 and 1. front_rank_line is where the front rank's men stand along the facing (the dump's facing is (-1, 0), so the value is minus x): the line the front stood on, -652.5, to a quarter of the 9 wu rank pitch, at ticks 480 to 600, where main's front rank stands 30.83 wu back (-683.33). Measured 2026-11-12 with FULL 2-tick dumps on seeds 0 to 4 for main, which played out identically on every seed, and seed 0 for this build: main fa620333 had a pair within a body radius on 90 of the 278 dumps every 2 ticks from tick 46, just after the order, to 600, closest 2.23 wu at tick 124; this build had none, closest 8.89 wu at tick 468, and its front rank stood at -652.5 from tick 480 and -652.53 at tick 600. While the drill runs the dumped slots are each man's place behind or beside the man he follows. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
